fixes: A tier now covers the account positions up to and including its up_to; it used to stop one unit short of it.
Units are rated from the position they hold among the account's units over all its meters instead of restarting the tiers at every meter.
A standing line is now the sum, over the meter's active days, of the standing charge of the day divided by the days of that day's own month, in place of a flat 30-day month.
The standing charge of a day follows the plan's standing_changes entry with the latest from date on or before that day.
Every amount is computed from the decimal values as written in the input files with exact fractions and rounded half to even to 0.01, instead of binary floats.
Added the allowance sharing of the energy lines: equal parts capped at a line's exact value, re-shared while some stays unshared, and the remainder reported back.

The commitment credit is now measured on the invoice subtotal rather than on a second base that also rated refused reads, the total is the discounted subtotal rounded half to even and the credit is what the total takes off the subtotal.
Added the voucher redemption: the largest voucher sum not above the balance, taking the set whose id list comes first.
